# Greenfield — Task Outline

## Template Info

- **Name:** Greenfield
- **Original:** ColorLib "Farmland" (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/farmland/)
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/farmland/
- **Type:** Farm & Agriculture Landing Page
- **Stack:** Vite + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript

## Design Tokens

- Brand green: `#5d8c55` (buttons, accents)
- Dark green: `#486c42` (hover states)
- Gold accent: `#ecdc67` (secondary accents)
- Dark text: `#141b25`
- Body font: Roboto (300, 400, 500, 700)
- Accent font: Covered By Your Grace (handwritten subheadings)

## Section Breakdown

1. **TopBar** — email + social icons (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Dribbble)
2. **BrandBar** — Sprout icon logo + "Greenfield" + "Agriculture Farming" tagline, phone, address
3. **Navbar** — dark bg, 6 nav links + "Get A Quote" CTA, mobile hamburger
4. **Hero** — full-height bg image, overlay, welcome text, heading, description, 2 CTA buttons
5. **Services** — 4 cards: Fresh Vegetables, Agricultural Products, Organic Products, Dairy Products
6. **About** — split layout: image with experience badge + heading + features + CTA
7. **Counter** — 4 stats over bg image: 4800, 14000, 200, 71650
8. **Projects** — 4 portfolio cards with bg images
9. **Video** — bg image + play button + heading
10. **Testimonials** — carousel with 3 testimonials
11. **RequestQuote** — form (5 fields + submit) + FAQ accordion (3 items)
12. **Blog** — 3 blog cards with images, meta, title, excerpt
13. **Newsletter** — bg image + subscribe form
14. **Footer** — 4 columns (About, Posts, Links, Contact) + copyright bar with Component Dock link

## Implementation Notes

- All images via `picsum.photos` with seed params
- Icons via `lucide-react` (Sprout, Leaf, TreePine, Milk, CheckCircle, etc.)
- Google Fonts: Roboto + Covered By Your Grace
- No Colorlib references in app code
- Footer links to https://www.componentdock.com/
